title.zh: 哈萨克斯坦法院禁止Coinbase等6家CEX在阿斯塔纳国际金融中心无牌运营
title.en: 哈萨克斯坦法院禁止Coinbase等6家CEX在阿斯塔纳国际金融中心无牌运营

current_state.zh: An AIFC court in Kazakhstan granted the financial regulator's request for injunctions barring Coinbase, BingX, Bitcoin.com, WEEX and two other centralized exchanges from offering or promoting unlicensed digital asset services and distributing their apps within the Astana International Financial Centre's jurisdiction.
current_state.en: An AIFC court in Kazakhstan granted the financial regulator's request for injunctions barring Coinbase, BingX, Bitcoin.com, WEEX and two other centralized exchanges from offering or promoting unlicensed digital asset services and distributing their apps within the Astana International Financial Centre's jurisdiction.
